Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original narrative editorial illustration, one horizontal full-bleed image.
Primary request: a tiny fictional red field mouse ferries one glowing dandelion seed across a moonlit pond in a folded leaf boat. The story is about taking care of something much larger than oneself, told without words.
Scene/backdrop: a shallow dark pond seen at reed height, distant grass silhouettes and a large softly textured cream moon. A few concentric ripples make the boat's motion understandable.
Subject: one small red-brown mouse with a coherent simple anatomy, round ears, a single curling tail, a small unbranded ochre scarf, seated inside one folded green leaf boat. It gently holds the stem of one oversized dandelion parachute whose delicate white filaments catch the light. The mouse is an original character, not based on a known franchise.
Style/medium: hand-painted opaque gouache and visible colored-pencil accents on rough ivory paper; slightly irregular handmade edges; beautifully controlled flat shapes, no glossy 3D look.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, mouse and leaf boat in lower right, moon in upper left, strong diagonal conversation between moon and glowing seed; reeds act as a sparse dark framing silhouette; generous simple dark negative space.
Lighting/mood: intimate, brave, tranquil nighttime fairytale; seed glow is gentle and local, not neon; the moon reflects as broken pale shapes on the pond.
Color palette: deep indigo, slate teal, parchment cream, muted ochre and small brick-red accent.
Text: none.
Constraints: no words, typography, brands, watermark, humans, multiple mice, duplicated tails, extra limbs, exaggerated huge eyes, stock clip-art style, busy star field, or imitation of any living artist. Keep one clear storytelling moment.
